away.summary: The Vancouver Canucks are on a road trip, having played the Islanders on October 13 and preparing to face the Florida teams next. No specific lineup or injury information for the upcoming game against the Panthers is provided in the articles; the focus is on past games and general team attitude.

home.summary: The Florida Panthers are projected to start Akira Schmid in goal against the Blue Jackets on October 13, with several key players out due to injury (Barkov, Marchand, Gadjovich, Markstrom, Gudas) and Conor Garland a game-time decision. The team did not hold a morning skate after a loss to Buffalo, and Cooper Black was recalled to back up Schmid.
